name: teddy-pose-atlas
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production animation pose sprite atlas for a romantic Cappadocia countdown website.
Create ONE wide transparent PNG canvas, exactly 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1024 pixels. Divide it conceptually into FOUR columns and TWO rows of EXACTLY equal SQUARE cells: 8 independent scenes. No visible grid, no labels, no borders. Genuinely transparent RGBA background (alpha=0 around artwork), NOT an opaque checkerboard or paper backdrop.
In EVERY cell show the SAME TWO adorable plump teddy characters, fully visible head to toe, consistent scale, same baseline, ample empty transparent gutter to each cell edge. Blue boy on left, pink girl on right except rotations demanded by hugging pose. Care-Bears-inspired cuddly proportions, but their personal belly badges are simple huge ROUND WHITE circles, not other motifs. Powder blue male with little blue bowtie and uppercase letter "T" centered in white belly badge; blush pink female with little head bow, eyelashes and uppercase letter "Z" centered in white belly badge. Keep badge lettering correct where front is visible.
Style: romantic hand-drawn colored-pencil storybook illustration, soft pastel pencil fill with visibly scratchy graphite outlines and sweet expressive faces, tactile softly irregular shading. Absolutely no glossy rendering, 3D, vector look, or hard saturated colors.
CELL ORDER, read left to right top row, then left to right bottom row:
1: Both standing next to each other facing viewer with paws forward.
2: Pink leaning toward blue and giving his cheek a kiss; blue blushing.
3: Blue placing both arms around pink to embrace her.
4: Tight affectionate hug, couple facing viewer.
5: Same hugging couple seen side-on.
6: Same hugging couple seen from behind, same bow and colors, no letters on backs.
7: Both standing side by side, paws together holding ONE shared long horizontal handle on a little vintage AIR PUMP between them. Handle raised UP. Pump body pale mauve and ivory. Thin black hose exits toward right edge but stays within this cell.
8: Identical pump scene, same composition, but paws and the shared handle pushed DOWN and both bodies leaning down, an alternate animation frame.
All 8 scenes use the same ground baseline and framing, with full bodies and nothing cropped. No background landscape, no separate balloons, no extra objects beyond the pump in last two cells. No shadows stretching into adjacent cells. Exactly eight equal square cells and exactly two bears per cell.

name: cappadocia-landscape
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished raster background illustration for a romantic countdown website.
Create a wide 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536x1024. Romantic hand-drawn pastel colored pencil on very pale warm ivory paper. A recognizable Cappadocia landscape with fairy chimneys, soft volcanic rock formations and undulating valleys, concentrated entirely along the BOTTOM THIRD of the canvas. The rocks are softly colored blush pink, lavender, pale sand and warm cream, with delicate textured graphite and pencil details. Small hot-air balloons in powder blue, pale pink and lavender float in the pale sunrise sky mostly at the far outer edges. Keep the CENTRAL UPPER TWO THIRDS of the sky almost empty and luminous pale ivory so website text can be overlaid. Delicate soft sunrise atmosphere, realistic Cappadocia location cues interpreted as a tender illustrated storybook scene. Softly irregular pencil grain, gentle low contrast, refined handmade charm.
No text, no interface, no people, no bears, no watermark. Finished landscape artwork, not a website screenshot.

name: pink-hot-air-balloon
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent standalone hot-air balloon sprite for a romantic countdown website.
Create a square transparent RGBA PNG canvas, ideally 1024x1024, with ONE front-view hot-air balloon centered, fully visible with lots of empty transparent padding on every side. Genuinely transparent alpha background, not white paper, not checkerboard texture.
The balloon envelope has softly rounded vertical stripes in blush pink, warm cream and pale lavender; a tiny delicate wicker basket hangs underneath by short ordinary balloon supports. Romantic hand-drawn colored-pencil illustration with scratchy fine graphite outlines, softly irregular handmade pastel shading and tactile pencil grain. Cute, gentle, light, airy and elegant. No glossy surfaces, no 3D, no vector look. Balloon and basket centered along the same vertical axis, entire object visible, envelope approximately half the canvas width.
No other objects, no landscape, no bears, no text, no watermark, no loose string beyond the basket. The transparent image will be scaled by CSS to suggest inflation.
